description: This file declares functions and includes relevant headers for controlling the idle valve in an engine management system. It defines function prototypes for getting/setting idle positions, starting threads, and adjusting configuration parameters related to idle control.

methods.name: getIdlePosition
methods.description: Returns the current position of the idle valve as a percentage.

methods.name: setIdleValvePosition
methods.description: Sets the idle valve position to the specified percentage.

methods.name: startIdleThread
methods.description: Starts the idle control thread, using a shared logger object.

methods.name: setDefaultIdleParameters
methods.description: Resets or sets default parameters for idle control.

methods.name: startIdleBench
methods.description: Begins an idle control benchmarking or calibration process.

methods.name: setIdleDT
methods.description: Sets the idle delta time parameter.

methods.name: setIdleOffset
methods.description: Adjusts the idle control offset parameter.

methods.name: setIdlePFactor
methods.description: Sets the proportional factor for idle control.

methods.name: setIdleIFactor
methods.description: Sets the integral factor for idle control.

methods.name: setIdleDFactor
methods.description: Sets the derivative factor for idle control.

methods.name: setIdleMode
methods.description: Configures the idle mode to the specified mode.

methods.name: setTargetIdleRpm
methods.description: Sets the target RPM for idle control.

methods.name: onConfigurationChangeIdleCallback
methods.description: Handles configuration changes for idle parameters.
